```{r}
#| label: Parameters

threshold <- .8
model_type <- 'DINA'
design <- 'no_testlet'
num_attr <- '5attr'
est_type <- 'mle_gdina'

attr1 <- 'expectations_of_functions'

attr5 <- 'properties_of_variance'
```

# Data Ingestion & Preprocessing

```{r}
#| label: DataFrame & Q-Matrix Loading

data <- read_csv(here::here(glue('{data_directory}')))

df <-
data |>
  select(
    -c(
      1,
      item35,
      anon_id # remove for cdmTools model
    )
  )
df

qmatrix <- read_csv(here::here(glue('{q_directory}'))) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  filter(
    item != 35
  )

q <- 
qmatrix |>
  select(
    -c(
      x1,
      question, # remove if no testlet design,
      item # remove for cdmTools model
    )
  )
```

# Model 

```{r}
set.seed(7102026)
dina_mod <- GDINA(dat = df,
             Q = q,
             model = model_type,
             att.dist = "saturated",
             niter = 2000,
             maxitr = 2000
             )
summary(dina_mod)
```

## Comparisons Between Counts Correct & Counts Estimated


```{r}
#| label: RMSE from model-implied predictions

# I x C matrix of P(correct | latent class) for each item
lc_prob <- extract(dina_mod, what = "LCprob.parm")

# N x C matrix of each respondent's posterior class-membership
# probabilities (soft/EAP-style classification, not hard MAP/MLE)
log_post <- indlogPost(dina_mod)
post <- exp(log_post)
post <- post / rowSums(post)

# model-implied P(correct) per respondent x item = post %*% t(lc_prob)
y_hat <- post %*% t(lc_prob)
y_obs <- as.matrix(extract(dina_mod, "dat"))

```

```{r}
estimated_correct <-
y_hat |>
  as_tibble() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~if_else(.x > .5, 1, 0)
    ),
    total = rowSums(
      across(
        everything()
      )
    )
  ) |>
  rowid_to_column()

actual_correct <- 
  extract(dina_mod, "dat") |>
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(
      across(
        everything()
      )
    )
  ) |>
  rowid_to_column()

full_join(
  actual_correct |>
  mutate(dataset = "actual") |>
  select(
    rowid,
    act_total = total,
    dataset
  ),
  estimated_correct |>
    mutate(dataset = "estimated") |>
    select(
      rowid,
      est_total = total,
      dataset
  )
) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(
      rowid,
      dataset
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    dataset
  ) |>
  count(
    value
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  drop_na(value) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      value,
      n
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = dataset
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 34),
    breaks = seq(1, 34, 1)
  ) +
  see::scale_color_okabeito()

```

## Probability of Membership in Latent Classes

```{r}
lat_class_member <- 
personparm(dina_mod, type = "mp") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    class_label = paste0(a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)
  )

class_membership <-
tibble(
  "id" = data$anon_id, 
  "latent_class" = lat_class_member$class_label
)

class_membership
```

## Proportions of Latent Classes


## Probability of Attribute Mastery

```{r}
set.seed(7102026)
person_est <-
cat_map(
  c("mp", "MLE", "MAP"),
  ~personparm(dina_mod, what = .x)
)

person_est[[1]] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    stu = data$anon_id
  ) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  pivot_longer(
    -stu
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      stu,
      value
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    color = "seagreen"
    ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = threshold,
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dotted"
    ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(
      name
    )
  )


person_thresh80 <-
person_est[[1]] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    stu = data$anon_id
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      -stu,
      ~if_else(.x >= .8, 1, 0)
    )
  )

person_est[[2]] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  head()

person_est[[3]] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  head()

write.csv(person_est[[1]] |>
          as_tibble() |>
            mutate(
              stu = data$anon_id
            ),
          resp_proficieny_raw_list_directory
          )

write.csv(person_thresh80,
          resp_proficiency_list_directory
          )
```

## Slipping & Guessing

```{r}
sg <- 
coef(dina_mod, "gs") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    item = attributes(coef(dina_mod, "gs"))$dimnames[[1]]
  ) |>
  relocate(
    item,
    .before = 'guessing'
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-item)

sg <-
sg |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        name,
        item
      ),
      ~as.factor(.x)
    ),
    item = fct_relevel(
      item,
      cat_map(1:34, ~glue('Item {.x}'))
    )
  )

sg |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      item,
      value
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = name
    )
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(
      name
    )
  ) +
  see::scale_color_okabeito() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Discrimination of Each Item

```{r}
extract(dina_mod, "discrim") |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    item = glue("item{seq(1, 34, 1)}"),
    item = as.factor(item),
    item = fct_relevel(
      item,
      cat_map(1:34, ~glue('item{.x}'))
    )
  ) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(
    item,
    dis_diff = p_1_p_0,
    gdi

  ggplot(
    aes(
      item,
      dis_diff

  ) +
  geom_point(
    color = "seagreen"
  ) + 
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}

rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_obs - y_hat)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

rmse

  tibble(
    design = design,
    model = model_type,
    prior = est_type,
    num_attr = num_attr,
    rmse = rmse
  ),
  here::here(glue('fit_metrics/rlang_{model_type}_{design}_{est_type}_{num_attr}_fitmetrics.csv'))
)

```

# Model Diagnostics: Actual vs. Predicted (Expected vs. Observed)

This check evaluates MLE fit by comparing actual observed item pass rates against the probabilities predicted by the DINA model using a grouped bar chart. Substantial discrepancies between the bars indicate items where the model fails to fit the actual data structure.


# Latent Classes

Distribution of respondents across the dominant latent profile classes. This highlights the primary learning profiles present in the classroom by displaying only the most populated classes.

# Proficiency/Mastery

Posterior probabilities indicating student mastery per attribute. The dashed horizontal line represents the threshold ($>0.8$) for mastery assignment. This clean dot plot exposes whether student probabilities are clustering tightly at the boundaries (typical of MLE).


# Item-Level Slipping & Guessing

Point estimates for Slipping ($s$) and Guessing ($g$) mapped dynamically across all items. A dumbbell structure flags problematic items where the guessing parameter exceeds the non-guessing parameter, or where slipping is unusually high.



# Item Correctness Probabilities across Latent Classes



# Reliability

Accuracy measures the mean maximum classification certainty, and consistency evaluates decision reproducibility.

> *Note on perfect reliability metrics ($1.000$):* Optimization via L-BFGS MLE can drive individual posterior probabilities to boundary values ($0.0$ or $1.0$). When $p \in \{0, 1\}$, accuracy ($\max(p, 1-p)$) and consistency ($p^2 + (1-p)^2$) mathematically resolve to exactly $1.000$.
